proposals.title: Independent Board Chairman
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a policy requiring the Chairman of the Board to be an independent director, separate from the CEO, with phase-in at CEO transition.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends that shareholders vote AGAINST this proposal for the following reasons:

proposals.title: Fossil fuel phase out
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a time-bound policy phasing out JPM lending and underwriting to companies engaging in new fossil fuel exploration and development.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Amending public responsibility committee charter to include mandate to oversee animal welfare impact and risk
proposals.topic_summary: Requests revising the Public Responsibility Committee charter to include oversight of material animal welfare issues.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Special shareholder meeting improvement
proposals.topic_summary: Requests equal right for street name and registered shares to call a special meeting and lowering the threshold from 20% to 10% of shares.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Report on climate transition planning
proposals.proponent: As You Sow, on behalf of Catherine Raphael
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report disclosing a transition plan aligning financing with 2030 sectoral greenhouse gas reduction targets, with measures and timelines.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Report on ensuring respect for civil liberties
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report evaluating how the Board oversees risks of discrimination based on race, religion, sex, national origin or political views in services.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Report analyzing the congruence of the company's political and electioneering expenditures
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report analyzing whether political and electioneering expenditures align with publicly stated company values and policies.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.

proposals.title: Absolute GHG reduction goals
proposals.proponent: The Comptroller of the City of New York, on behalf of the New York City Employees' Retirement System, the New York City Teachers' Retirement System, and the New York City Board of Education Retirement System
proposals.topic_summary: Requests a report disclosing 2030 absolute GHG reduction targets for lending in Oil and Gas and Power Generation sectors aligned with net zero pathway.
proposals.evidence: The Board of Directors recommends a vote AGAINST this proposal.
